summary: Canaan Inc. filed a 6-K announcing a share repurchase program funded by monetizing a portion of its digital asset treasury. Repurchases of ADSs will be executed under the existing board authorization effective December 12, 2025. The company holds digital assets worth approximately US$130 million as of August 3, 2026, and believes its market value is below the combined value of digital assets and cash. Management cites disciplined capital allocation and shareholder value creation. No specific share numbers, price, or premium were provided. The program is subject to board oversight and market conditions, with no set expiration or commitment amount.
